request.description: Text and chunks mixed, an invoice (not in the RL -> OTHER) and a file with empty text (error row). counts[] compares your expected count with what was found; by_type counts classified files per RL type plus OTHER.

exec: pm.test("count check for every RL type", () => pm.expect(j.counts.map(c => c.rl)).to.have.members(["MSA","SOW","NDA","MoM"]));
pm.test("the invoice is confidently OTHER (final)", () => pm.expect(j.by_type.OTHER).to.eql(1));
pm.test("empty text becomes an error row, the run still succeeds", () => pm.expect(j.by_status.error).to.eql(1));
